purpose: Teach: 文中/合弁/集大成/係長/特設/別冊/交替/年率

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 契約書の文中、誤解を招く表現を直しましょう
lines.en: Let's fix the misleading phrasing in the contract text.
lines.style: Clear, efficient directive. Slight forward lean in posture. Warm but businesslike — she's not asking, she's guiding. Light emphasis on 'fix'. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。合弁先との打ち合わせを設定しました
lines.en: Done. I've scheduled a meeting with the joint venture partner.
lines.style: Straightforward confirmation, delivered with quiet competence. No flourish — just reporting completion. Brief pause before the detail, like checking his notes mentally.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 創業二十年の集大成イベントを企画しましょう
lines.en: Let's plan an event that brings together twenty years of what we've built.
lines.style: Steady, purposeful. Slight weight on the vision — she's not just assigning a task, she's framing it as meaningful. Unhurried pace. Slight lift at the end, inviting buy-in.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。係長クラスの研修を実施します
lines.en: Understood. I'll implement the training program for section-level staff.
lines.style: Attentive, ready to execute. Slight nod in the voice — he's listening and already mentally organizing. Professional but warm underneath. No rush.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 展示会の特設会場の手配を急ぎましょう
lines.en: Let's prioritize getting the special exhibition venue arranged.
lines.style: Gentle urgency without alarm. She's directing but not panicking. Breath controlled. Forward momentum in the phrasing — this matters, let's move on it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様向けの別冊カタログを準備しました
lines.en: Got it. I've prepared a special catalog for our key clients.
lines.style: Bright, satisfied — he's completed something tangible. Short, clipped syllables on the opening. A small pride in the work. Efficient close.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: シフト交替時の引き継ぎを丁寧にしましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure shift handovers are thorough and considerate.
lines.style: Quiet authority with care underneath. She's setting a standard about how people should treat each other. Deliberate pacing. Slight emphasis on 'considerate' — that word matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。融資の年率比較表を作成しました
lines.en: Done. I've put together a loan interest rate comparison table.
lines.style: Final checklist item, delivered with quiet satisfaction. Slight exhale on the opening — the work is complete. Grounded, professional close to the exchange.
